items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: The interviewee narrates a story involving 'Chink' being pranked by others ('Tainsey and Abby and that Georgie'), but does not describe a direct personal relationship with Chink.

ctx.x: wasn't it? Yeah. That's the fella, that's the band, too, Chink, Martin, and all is on there. That's in, there he is.
Oh, yeah, that's good. I never saw that before out on the street. Oh,
